admission: governed-element rule: clearly related to StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#431 (organization-ledger onboarding), which designates the location this transition pins

trigger.wiring_reason: No existing event-triggered workflow fires in this repository on an org-ledger record. The org's own record-triggered pattern (StegVerse-org/.github intr-path-ingress.yml and intr-path-transfer.yml, workflow_run on 'Organization Ledger Main Merge Transfer') fires only inside StegVerse-org/.github, because workflow_run selects workflows of the same repository; refs/stegverse/organization-ledger is neither a branch nor a tag, so a push filter cannot select it; and repository_dispatch, workflow_dispatch and schedules are excluded. The entrypoint is therefore documented, and the transition is bound to the record by its input, not by a clock.

entrypoint: scripts/llm_adapter_repository_ledger_genesis_pin.py plan --org-ledger <read-only copy of refs/stegverse/organization-ledger> --genesis-receipt <sha256 named by the receipted genesis record>
reads: the namespace chain from repository-ledger/StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter/HEAD.json back to its sealed REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION root

writes.value: the observed genesis receipt_sha256, read back; never computed in advance

consumes_receipt: a REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN repository receipt appended by .stegverse/transition-ledger/emit.py (unchanged) whose evidence.consumes_receipt_sha256 is the genesis receipt_sha256 and whose predecessor and successor state digests are the contract bytes before and after
idempotent: a contract already pinned to the observed genesis plans no write and no receipt
